simple.meaning: אֹבֵד (ʼôbêd) is a Hebrew word meaning “(concrete) wretched or (abstract) destruction.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אֹבֵד (H8) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 24:20, with occurrences in Numbers.
